## Services
- **AI Engineering & Automation**: AI built into the product, not bolted on: language-model features, automations and AI-assisted research that save your team hours. Skills: LLM Integrations, Prompt Engineering, AI Automation, AI Research, AI Image Gen, AI Scriptwriting. Proof: AI-assisted research and content pipelines at Nepal Bhoomi and for freelance clients.
- **Full-Stack Web Development**: Fast, responsive websites and web platforms, from database to pixel, built to run a real business. Skills: HTML & CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, PHP & Laravel, MySQL & MongoDB. Proof: HRMS, Fitfutures and First Math at Uno Technology.
- **App Development & Integrations**: Mobile and web apps with payments, logins and live data wired in properly. Skills: Mobile Apps, Web Apps, REST APIs, Khalti Payments, Auth & Roles, Django. Proof: Khalti payments and shipping APIs for Sayapatri at Ek Ra Sunya.
- **AI Video Production**: Scroll-stopping video made faster with AI: scripts, visuals, edits, grading and motion. Skills: AI Video, Video Editing, Motion Graphics, Color Grading, Remotion, Thumbnails. Proof: 3–4 property videos a day at Nepal Bhoomi, plus an AI-made YouTube channel.
- **SEO & Marketing Research**: Research what your customers search for, then rank for it, on Google and in AI answers. Skills: Technical SEO, Keyword Research, SEO Content, Market Research, Audience Analytics, YouTube SEO. Proof: SEO captions, keyword research and audience analysis at Nepal Bhoomi.
- **Ad Campaigns, Growth & Branding**: Paid campaigns, brand and funnels that turn attention into customers, measured every month. Skills: Google Ads, Meta Ads, Growth Marketing, E-commerce Marketing, Branding, Performance Reports. Proof: Ad performance tracking and monthly growth reports at Nepal Bhoomi.

## Experience
- **Nepal Bhoomi** (Lazimpat, Kathmandu): Video Editor, Designer & Growth Marketing. Produce 3–4 property videos a day, from script to edit to publishing. Run SEO captions, content calendars and audience research for buyers. Track retention and ad performance; present monthly growth reports.
- **Freelance** (Remote): AI Video Producer. Promotional and explainer videos for schools and consultancies. IELTS, GRE, SAT and study-abroad topics made clear and watchable. Podcasts cut into shorts, plus an AI-made YouTube channel.
- **Ek Ra Sunya Inc.** (Balkumari, Lalitpur): Backend Developer. Backend for the Sayapatri e-commerce platform. Integrated Khalti payments and MailQuote shipping costs. Live exchange rates with USD to AUD conversion.
- **Uno Technology** (Gyaneshwor, Kathmandu): Full-Stack Web Developer. A Laravel HRMS with payroll, leave, attendance and dashboards. Fitfutures, an e-learning and school management system. First Math, a three-level quiz game with live scoring.
